# Confetti

> Confetti is a curated city concierge that turns your night out into a timed, ready-to-book itinerary — first stop, second stop, transit between them, reservations included.

Confetti plans full evenings in seconds: dining, nightlife, experiences, and the logistics in between. Built for date nights, group hangs, family outings, and spontaneous "change my night" moves.
